content: Step 3 removes the methanesulfonyl azetidine, which is 136 Da of saturated sulfonamide responsible for SA 2.07 and TPSA 91 while contributing no NH-azine link of its own. Adding a fluorine inserts it immediately after the carbon that carries it and shifts only the indices beyond that point, so atom 7 is still the exocyclic amide carbonyl and atom 6 still the azetidine ring carbon; that bond is non-ring. I attach an ethyl rather than a methyl, which makes this a propanamide at about 259 Da - deliberately distinct from the acetanilide leader and from the cyclopropanecarboxamide analogues I built this generation, while keeping two rotatable bonds, LogP near 3.0 and SA under 1.9.
